name: The Candy Volcano
description: A whimsical, colorful volcano erupting sweet jellybeans, lollipops, and cotton candy clouds into a pastel sky, creating a delightful and playful landscape.
prompt: A whimsical volcano made of chocolate and rock candy, erupting colorful jellybeans, giant lollipops, and fluffy pink cotton candy clouds into a pastel sky, vibrant colors, playful, highly detailed, fantasy art, 8k, sweet and magical atmosphere.
caption: A sweet eruption of pure joy! 🍬 erupting into the sky. What kind of candy would you catch?
